The table test

01

Set your phone down.

Screen facing up, with stable contact on the table. Keep this page visible.

  1. 00–05sHands off. Let it settle.
  2. 05–15sLeave the table completely still.
  3. 15–25sTap lightly, about 20 cm away. Space taps apart.
  4. 25–35sMake a few firmer taps at the same distance.
  5. 35–45sGently press the phone down, then release.

The first 5 seconds set the graph’s baseline. Every available reading is recorded, including settling. A slow, steady press may produce little movement.

What is actually being measured? +

Safari supplies accelerometer and rotation readings. We save each delivered motion event with its time, acceleration, acceleration including gravity, rotation, and current test step. The graph shows acceleration relative to the starting baseline; tilting or picking up the phone also changes it.

* Peak excludes the first 5 seconds of a recording. The delivery rate is measured from incoming events, not a promised hardware rate. Tiny or very fast vibrations may be missed. A flat graph does not prove that the table did not vibrate.

Recording runs while this page is visible. Switching apps or locking the screen stops the session. A gap of more than 3 seconds without usable readings also stops it. Free recording is limited to 10 minutes.

No microphone, camera, or accessibility access. Recordings stay in this browser until you explicitly share them. The latest finished recording is stored locally when browser storage is available; export it before clearing browser data.
